release_notes: Feature release: time on the landing is measured for every visitor — visible seconds and scroll depth written into the click, with Time on LP / LP bounce rate / LP scroll depth / LP measured visits metrics and a Time on LP (bucket) dimension. The Telegram bot now works on bare-IP installs via a polling mode, with honest scheme detection behind proxies and the real Telegram error on screen. The click funnel says what it means: clicks are the offer funnel, pre-bound landing views count as visitors, and CPV/EPV divide by visitors. The Campaigns table pins its identity columns while wide column sets scroll, and TikTok/Meta CAPI payloads carry content_id (PR #8).
